regions.today: Staying dry for most this afternoon and evening with a mix of cloud and bright or sunny spells, and just the odd spot of light rain or drizzle possible, with a moderate, occasionally fresh, southeasterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 11 degrees, with a moderate to fresh southeasterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Continuing generally dry with a mix of cloud and bright or sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees, with a moderate southeasterly breeze, easing in the evening.
